findings.area: agenda row — Bank of Utah Championship (I DAG)
findings.issue: Channel reads "HBO Max (Sport) +1" — the "+1" time-shift suffix is a UK/international channel-numbering convention, not the Norwegian format used by every other row on the board (Viaplay, TV 2 Play, TV 2 Direkte). Same text appears at 393px and 900px. Worth a data check on whether this is actually the correct Norwegian viewing option for this event rather than an unfiltered international feed.

notes: No horizontal overflow or clipped/truncated text at any of the three widths — all match names and channel labels wrap onto additional lines rather than being cut off.
Flags (Portugal–Norge) and tour/club badges render as real images, no broken-image icons.
Must-see accent dots are used sparingly (a handful of rows across the whole agenda), consistent with the calm-design guarantee.
Header, day headings, 'Dette dekker vi'/'Merk og kilder' disclosures, and footer (incl. AI-budsjett status line) are all intact and aligned at every width.

The floating Assistent button (visible in the 900px capture, resting over the 'Ceuta 6 de Junio – UB Lebrijana' row) does not occlude the last agenda row or the footer — matches the DESIGN.md-sanctioned floating-button pattern, not flagged.

The Assistent button was not visible at all in the 375px/393px full-page captures — most likely a full-page-screenshot artifact with a fixed-position element rather than a real absence, since it rendered fine at 900px; flagging here as an observation only, not a finding.

'CD San José – Auriense Cented Academy' (Copa del Rey) looks like an odd/truncated-looking team name, but it renders identically at all three widths including the 900px desktop shot, so it is not a CSS truncation bug — likely the actual scraped fixture name. Noting for a data sanity check, not raising as a layout finding.
